from sensor_data sd join warehouse w on sd.warehouse_id = w.id join sensor_metric sm on sd.metric_code = sm.metric_code where (#{warehouseId} is null or sd.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}) and (#{metricCode} is null or #{metricCode} = '' or sd.metric_code = #{metricCode})
and ( w.warehouse_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or sm.metric_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or sd.metric_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
mapper.select: order by sd.collected_at asc, sd.id asc
order by sd.collected_at desc, sd.id desc limit #{pageSize} offset #{offset}
select * from sensor_data where id = #{id} limit 1

select sd.id, sd.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, sd.metric_code, sm.metric_name, sd.metric_value, sm.unit, sd.collected_at, sd.source_type, sd.quality_flag from sensor_data sd join warehouse w on sd.warehouse_id = w.id join sensor_metric sm on sd.metric_code = sm.metric_code where sd.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and sd.metric_code = #{metricCode} order by sd.collected_at asc limit 24
mapper.insert: insert into sensor_data ( warehouse_id, metric_code, metric_value, collected_at, source_type, source_batch_no, quality_flag, remark, created_by ) values ( #{warehouseId}, #{metricCode}, #{metricValue}, #{collectedAt}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceBatchNo}, #{qualityFlag}, #{remark}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.update: update sensor_data set warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}, metric_code = #{metricCode}, metric_value = #{metricValue}, collected_at = #{collectedAt}, source_type = #{sourceType}, source_batch_no = #{sourceBatchNo}, quality_flag = #{qualityFlag}, remark = #{remark}, created_by = #{createdBy} where id = #{id}
